title: Feelings
examples: What does it feel like when I am very happy?
If I am angry, what should I do?
Can you show me what scared looks like?

explain.say: Today we are learning about feelings. Feelings are how we feel inside.
When you are happy, you feel light and bouncy. A big smile shows you are happy.
When you are sad, your face might droop a little. Sometimes you might want a hug.

draw.text: Sad: Droopy face, needs a hug

explain.say: When you are angry, your body might feel hot. You might want to stomp your feet.
When you are scared, your tummy might feel wiggly. You might want to hide under a blanket.
If your friend is crying, you can name the feeling. You can say, 'You seem sad.'

draw.text: Naming feelings: Name what you see

faq.q: How do I know if I am feeling angry?
faq.a: You might feel hot or want to stomp your feet. You can also feel tense in your body.
asks: How do I know I am mad?

faq.q: What should I do when I feel scared?
faq.a: It is okay to feel scared. You can take three slow, deep breaths to feel safer.
asks: How do I calm down from fear?
What helps when I am scared?

faq.q: Can I feel two feelings at once?
faq.a: Yes, you can. You might feel happy but also a little bit sad. That is okay.
asks: Can I be sad and happy?

faq.q: Why is it important to name my feelings?
faq.a: Naming your feelings helps you understand them better. It helps grown-ups help you too.
asks: Why say my feelings out loud?

faq.q: What is the best way to calm down?
faq.a: Taking slow, deep breaths is a good way to calm down. You can also count to ten slowly.
asks: How do I calm down when angry?

facts: It is normal to feel all different feelings.
Deep breaths help calm big feelings down.
A smile can help you feel happy.
It is okay to tell someone how you feel.

quiz.say: If you lose a favorite toy, you might feel:
quiz.why: Losing something you love often makes us feel sad.

wrong.0: Angry means you want to push something away.
wrong.1: Scared means you see something big and unknown.
wrong.3: Happy means everything is going well.

quiz.say: When you are very angry, what is a good first step?
quiz.why: Breathing slowly helps your body calm down when you feel hot.

wrong.0: Running away does not help you understand the feeling.
wrong.2: Yelling can make your voice tired and upset.
wrong.3: Stomping uses up energy but does not calm the feeling.

quiz.say: If you see a big dog suddenly, you might feel:
quiz.why: Seeing something unexpected or big can make us feel scared.

wrong.1: Happy means you feel safe and joyful.
wrong.2: Sadness comes from missing something or someone.
wrong.3: Anger usually comes from being treated unfairly.
